C01.text: Tenney et al. 2019 focuses on BERT, the model introduced in Devlin et al. 2018, and examines where linguistic information is captured within it, while Devlin et al. 2018 describes BERT as a pre-trained model that can be fine-tuned for a range of tasks.

C02.text: Tenney et al. 2019 cites Mikolov et al. 2013 as an example of static word embeddings that pre-trained sentence encoders such as BERT seem poised to displace as the basis for NLP systems.
